rows.section: Essential Components of All MHPSS Programmes
rows.en: As we saw before, Section 2 does not have any sector icons next to it because these activities relate to internal organizational processes and don’t require inter-sectoral coordination​
rows.ne: हामीले पहिले हेरेझैँ, खण्ड 2 को छेउमा कुनै पनि क्षेत्रका चिह्नहरू छैनन्, किनभने यी गतिविधिहरू संस्थाका आन्तरिक प्रक्रियासँग सम्बन्धित छन् र यिनका लागि अन्तरक्षेत्रीय समन्वय आवश्यक पर्दैन।
rows.bt: As we saw earlier, there are no symbols for any sectors beside Section 2, because these activities relate to the organization's internal processes and do not require intersectoral coordination.

rows.section: Essential Components of All MHPSS Programmes
rows.en: These activities are here to guide organizations internal work and systems.
rows.ne: यी गतिविधिहरू संस्थाहरूको आन्तरिक कार्य र प्रणालीहरूलाई मार्गदर्शन गर्न यहाँ समावेश गरिएका हुन्।
rows.bt: These activities are included here to guide organizations' internal work and systems.

rows.section: Essential Components of All MHPSS Programmes
rows.en: They are absolutely crucial for the planning and implementation of a safe and effective MHPSS response.
rows.ne: सुरक्षित र प्रभावकारी MHPSS प्रतिकार्यको योजना र कार्यान्वयनका लागि यी गतिविधिहरू अपरिहार्य छन्।
rows.bt: These activities are indispensable for planning and implementing a safe and effective MHPSS response.

rows.section: Essential Components of All MHPSS Programmes
rows.en: Organizations must have sound systems for program design, for coordination, for M&E, for caring for staff & volunteers and for building the MHPSS competencies of staff & volunteers.
rows.ne: संस्थाहरूसँग कार्यक्रमको डिजाइन, समन्वय, अनुगमन तथा मूल्याङ्कन (M&E), कर्मचारी र स्वयंसेवकको हेरचाह तथा कर्मचारी र स्वयंसेवकमा MHPSS सम्बन्धी सक्षमता विकासका लागि सुदृढ प्रणालीहरू हुनैपर्छ।
rows.bt: Organizations must have robust systems for program design, coordination, monitoring and evaluation (M&E), care for staff and volunteers, and development of MHPSS-related competence among staff and volunteers.
rows.note: Uses the proposed standalone term monitoring and evaluation (M&E) = [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] [Nepali wording recorded in terminology evidence] (M&E), drawn from supplied activity 2.2; glossary review pending.

rows.section: Essential Components of All MHPSS Programmes
rows.en: These are, however, activities that are often overlooked, although any organizations engaging in any type of MHPSS activity should always do these 4 activities.​
rows.ne: तर यी गतिविधिहरू प्रायः बेवास्तामा पर्छन्, यद्यपि कुनै पनि प्रकारको MHPSS गतिविधिमा संलग्न जुनसुकै संस्थाले यी 4 गतिविधि सधैँ गर्नु उचित हुन्छ।
rows.bt: But these activities are often neglected, although it is appropriate for any organization involved in any type of MHPSS activity to always carry out these 4 activities.
rows.note: The back-translation renders 'should always' as 'must always'; the revision distinguishes this recommendation from the preceding mandatory requirement. The source's count of 4 is retained; its relationship to the preceding five-item list remains pending source review. The back-translation weakens the explicit recommendation that organizations 'should always' perform the four activities to a statement that doing so 'is appropriate'.
